title: Local AI
model.flash.hint: Hard questions; slower, streams from SSD
model.selectHint: Click to switch. The loaded model unloads; this one loads on the first request.
now.offlineDetail: The local AI service is stopped. Chat or OpenCode starts it.
now.error.missing: The local-ai command did not start.
now.error.unreadable: The status answer could not be read.
now.retryTip: The panel checks again every 5 s.
now.resumingTip: The last conversation is being restored from disk. A new request takes over at once.
now.sessionCountdownIdle: Session ready · unloads after %1 min idle
now.sessionTip: The last conversation is restored; its next turn starts without re-reading it.
now.sessionTip.disk: The last conversation was restored from disk in %1 s; its next turn starts without re-reading it.
now.sessionTip.ram: The last conversation was restored from RAM in %1 s; its next turn starts without re-reading it.
now.stoppingDetail: Waiting for the engine to exit.
now.computeBusy: Another local AI task is using the compute slot.
mode.title: Context
mode.tip: How much of a conversation the model keeps before it summarises the older turns. Fast is the default. A change applies to the next OpenCode session.
mode.tipBusy: How much of a conversation the model keeps before it summarises the older turns. It can be changed on the selected model when no answer is running.
mode.fast.cost: Summarises most often, so each turn stays quick. Older details are shortened sooner.
mode.deep.cost: Summarises about half as often as Fast. Remembers more; turns get slower as the conversation grows.
mode.max.cost: Rarely summarises. Remembers the most; the slowest turns and the most RAM. Switching to or from Max unloads the model.
mode.keep: Keeps about %1 tokens before it summarises.
mode.reason.rss: its memory use at this size has not been measured on this laptop
mode.reason.stale: the engine was updated and its memory use at this size has not been measured again
mode.reason.memory: it needs more memory than this laptop can give it
mode.reason.none: this model or setup does not support it
notice.action: That did not work. Check free RAM, the battery level or a running task.
notice.start: %1 did not start. Check free RAM, then load again.
notice.harness: Could not warm up %1. Try again.
harness.title: Apps
harness.prepareCost: Warming up loads %1 if it is not loaded.
share.title: Sharing
share.off.tip: Only this laptop can use the models.
share.tailscale.tip: Recommended. Your own devices on your tailnet can use the models with the share key. The connection is encrypted.
share.lan.tip: Any device on this network can use the models with the share key. Plain HTTP unless TLS is set up: others on the network can read the traffic.
share.lanWarning: Plain HTTP: anyone on this network can read prompts, answers and the key. Tailscale is the safer choice.
share.confirm.tailscale: Share chat, completions and the model list with the devices on your tailnet? Each device needs the share key. The connection is encrypted.
share.confirm.lan: Share chat, completions and the model list with everyone on this network? Each device needs the share key, but the traffic is not encrypted. Tailscale is the safer choice.
share.inactive: Sharing is asked for but not running; only this laptop can use the models.
share.key: Key %1. Show it once with: local-ai share key
launch.studioNote: Studio unloads the chat model first.
activity.unavailable: This controller does not record requests yet.
activity.tip.resume.ram: Conversation resumed from RAM in %1 ms
activity.tip.resume.disk: Conversation resumed from disk in %1 ms
storage.unavailable: This controller does not list storage yet.
cache.title: Conversation cache
cache.unavailable: The cache is not reported yet.

cache.keptDays.one: Kept up to %1 day after last use.
cache.keptDays.other: Kept up to %1 days after last use.

cache.invalid: The saved budget was not valid. The default is in use.
cache.clearConfirm: Clear every saved conversation and the stored-prompt store? Each conversation's next turn, and each app's next first start, is computed again.
clear.title: Clear caches
clear.promptsNote: Each app is slower on its next first start (12 to 75 s).
clear.conversationsNote: Unloads the model. Open conversations are evaluated again from the start.
clear.harnessesNote: Apps disappear from the Models tab until each is used again.
flash.trial: A Flash test is running · %1 min

flash.cache.reason.preferred-does-not-fi: preferred tier does not fit now
flash.cache.reason.preferred-swap-tolera: idle desktop pages may go to swap
footer.pause: Pause updates. The panel refreshes every 5 s; refreshing never loads a model.
